title: f/2 Vitamin Solution Preparation
author: Christa Smith
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jv7cn9n

steps.title: Measure water base
steps.instruction: Measure 950 mL deionized water into a 1 L glass bottle.

steps.title: Dissolve thiamine HCl
steps.instruction: Add 200 mg thiamine·HCl (vitamin B1) to the bottle and dissolve completely.

steps.title: Add biotin stock
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL primary stock solution of biotin (vitamin H) (0.1 g/L in deionized water) to the bottle.

steps.title: Add cyanocobalamin stock
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL primary stock solution of cyanocobalamin (vitamin B12) (1.0 g/L in deionized water) to the bottle.

steps.title: Adjust final volume
steps.instruction: Bring the final volume to 1 L with deionized water.

steps.title: Filter sterilize solution
steps.instruction: Filter‑sterilize the final vitamin solution through a 0.2 µm PES membrane.

steps.title: Aliquot and freeze
steps.instruction: Store the filtered solution frozen in 0.5 mL aliquots.
